label: scope3-plan-correctness-past-threshold
description: Authored co-occurrence case: a plan-correctness finding surfacing past the threshold still forces a revision round (the honest non-shortening guarantee). Rounds 1-2 fix earlier findings; round 3 (== threshold) co-emits a first-occurrence verification-hardening finding (C3) AND a plan-correctness finding (C4). Because a round-forcing plan_correctness finding remains open, the round does NOT land accepted-with-debt (disposition request_revision). Under the Scope 4 arrival-time conversion the co-occurring first-occurrence hardening finding (C3) is still banked as deferred plan-review debt on arrival, while C4 keeps the round forced.
